ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Disregard the assessment notations listed above. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $362 per credit hour; the undergraduate tuition rate is $325 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. These per credit hour assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
